method: Viewed all 15 source PNGs (300 dpi) in full and cropped character-critical regions at native scale with PIL (dimension cells p3/p4, FCC NOTE/MODIFICATION, apostrophes p6/p13/p14, safety list p12). Extracted the built HTML text (tags stripped, img alt kept) and compared line-by-line with the source pixels and the Markdown. Located every PNG asset in the source pages with OpenCV matchTemplate (TM_CCOEFF_NORMED, multi-scale) and pixel-diffed each against its page region; checked a 40 px ring outside each crop for cut-off art (hits verified as neighbouring text/badges). Reviewed full-1280 and full-390 screenshots in slices for rendering (spans, bold header row, inbox badges, FCC, cards, back cover).

findings.source_text_or_pixels: -- Reorient or relocate the receiving antenna. (no bullet; '--' is the only marker)
findings.web_text: • -- Reorient or relocate the receiving antenna. (and the other 3 items)
findings.detail: The '--' markers are kept as text, as the convention says, but the <ul class="simple"> still draws a disc bullet, so each item has two markers ('• --'). The convention is applied only halfway: either remove the list bullet or drop the '--'.
findings.resolution: fixed: FCC '--' markers now become the shared list marker only (normalization recorded); no doubled marker.

findings.source_text_or_pixels: NOTE: / MODIFICATION: printed in the same regular weight as the body text
findings.detail: The web page adds bold that is not in the source. This is acceptable only if the shared HB-SPECIAL-FCC component requires it; it is not in the list of known conventions.
findings.resolution: accepted: label emphasis is drawn by the shared HB-SPECIAL-FCC component; not a package style.

findings.source_text_or_pixels: 'Do not step on or place heavy objects on the solar panels.' printed with no leading '*', directly after '* Do not put corrosive substance on the solar panels' (which has no full stop)
findings.web_text: Separate bullet: 'Do not step on or place heavy objects on the solar panels.'
findings.detail: The source line has no bullet marker. The web page promotes it to its own list item. This is probably the intended reading (a missing '*' in print), but it is an editorial change and should be recorded. The missing full stop on item 9 is correctly kept verbatim.
findings.resolution: recorded as operator decision D6 and in source_concerns.

findings.source_text_or_pixels: Package-list hinge drawing at about p5 (150-310, 740-960)
findings.web_text: assets/hinge.png = exact crop from p7 (1038,1779) (the Assembly-section hinge), also reused for the 'One hinge.' image
findings.detail: The drawing is the same, but the asset comes from page 7 at a larger scale, not from the package-list artwork. Visually equivalent; the provenance differs from the other nine inbox crops, which all come from p5.
findings.resolution: recorded in asset_decisions.inventory_checked and decision D9-class presentation note; same drawing reused once.

findings.web_location: PACKAGE LIST card labels at 1280 px
findings.source_text_or_pixels: 'Jackery SolarSaga 85 x 6' on one line; 'Anderson Rubber / Plug x 2' breaks before 'Plug'
findings.web_text: 'Jackery SolarSaga 85 x' / '6' and 'Anderson Rubber Plug x' / '2' (the quantity wraps alone)
findings.detail: There is no non-breaking space between 'x' and the quantity, so the number is orphaned on its own line. Use U+00A0 around 'x', or nowrap the 'x N' span.
findings.resolution: fixed: non-breaking spaces bind each quantity to its item label (normalization recorded).

findings.source_text_or_pixels: Title case: 'Single Solar Panel', 'Multiple Solar Panels'
findings.web_text: Rendered 'SINGLE SOLAR PANEL', 'MULTIPLE SOLAR PANELS' (text is title case in the DOM)
findings.detail: The theme also upper-cases h2, not only h1. The DOM text is correct. Noted only because the stated convention mentions h1.
findings.resolution: no action: note confirms intended convention

findings.web_text: DOM text verbatim; displayed upper-cased by theme ('NOT PERMITTED', 'JACKERY INC.')
findings.detail: Covered by the h1 upper-case theme convention. In print, these appear as same-level headings. Text verbatim.
findings.resolution: no action: note confirms intended convention

findings.web_text: 977 x 493 x 14mm in DOM (letter x); the font draws it like ×
findings.detail: Correct. The DOM keeps letter x as in the source, while the p4 Unfolded/Folded Size cells correctly use × as printed. The visual similarity comes from the font (known convention).
findings.resolution: no action: note confirms intended convention

findings.source_text_or_pixels: Caption 'The image is for reference only.' under the cover product image
findings.detail: The caption goes with the omitted cover product image, so its omission is consistent with the cover convention. Recorded for completeness.
findings.resolution: no action: note confirms intended convention

findings.source_text_or_pixels: Tel:1-888-502-2236(US)   E-mail:hello@jackery.com   Website:www.jackery.com on one line
findings.web_text: Three separate paragraphs, text verbatim (no space after colons, as printed)
findings.detail: Reflowed from one line to three. Characters match exactly. The QR crop matches the source exactly and all four edges are intact.
findings.resolution: no action: note confirms intended convention

findings.source_text_or_pixels: Crop box overlaps the end of the text line 'illustration below.'
findings.web_text: assets/storage-fold.png: pixel-identical to source except a whited-out top-left patch (x 0-207, y 0-22)
findings.detail: The neighbouring text was correctly masked, not included. The art is complete on all four sides (the bag stack top is intact).
findings.resolution: no action: note confirms intended convention

findings.web_text: full-390 screenshot shows the STC/BNPI/value columns clipped at the right edge of the table wrapper
findings.detail: The tables scroll horizontally inside the wrapper (there is no page-level horizontal scroll), so on a phone the values are hidden until the reader scrolls. Not a text-fidelity defect, but readers may miss the values.
findings.resolution: recorded as operator decision D3 (three-column table cannot use two-column HB-TABLE-SPEC; shared wrapper scrolls).

post_fix_source.note: Reviewed against the pre-fix render; the two fixes (F1, F5) only change list markers and space characters and were re-checked in the final 1280/390 render by the author.
